Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — Issue #⁠245596 reports the Shoper cookie-consent dialog on www⁠.4motos.pl ("Dbamy o Twoją prywatność") plus its dark page mask; the reporter profile reproduced both.
